summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the Custom Flippy Deck (deck-config) feature. All 8 backend cases (BACKEND-1..9, with 7+8 combined) passed via pytest — including next-year deck_config inheritance. Frontend: FRONTEND-1..3 verified end-to-end (dialog opens, locked state on Y1, preset+signature editor + save on unlocked). FRONTEND-4 (signature card face on FlippyDeck) verified — the signature card fires: toast '✨ Fumbleroski −8 yd' appears and the label is present in play-by-play DOM within an auto-play sample; the flippy-signature-card element renders during flip animation but is very short-lived so polling did not capture it in a screenshot (feature works, purely a test timing artifact).
critical_code_review_comments: flippy_deck.py: _AIR_RAID_CURVE and _CHAOS_CURVE do not sum to 98 (comments in file even note this — 103 and 93). _normalize_curve tries to correct but only patches the last/largest bucket, leaving distributions slightly skewed from author intent. Non-blocking (deck size is still forced to 250 via padding/trim), but worth cleaning up for predictability.

server.py:702 _deck_unlocked() also unlocks when year >= 2027 as a defensive fallback — could bypass the '2 completed seasons' rule for a franchise imported at year 2027 with empty champions_history. Consider dropping the year-based fallback or documenting explicitly.

FlippyDeck.jsx signature card face renders only while a card is being flipped; the data-testid disappears immediately after — consider persisting the last-flipped card face until the next play for easier QA/testing and slower visual feedback.
seed_data_creation: Two seasons created via /api/season/create: locked KC (id 636f6dbd..., champions_history=[]) and unlocked BUF (id 27895128..., champions_history seeded via Mongo direct with 2 entries).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_deck_config.py (pytest, 8 cases, ~50s). Fixtures create fresh seasons; next-year test skips gracefully if the current season isn't yet eligible (but on the last run it did execute and passed — inheritance verified end-to-end). Frontend note: FlippyDeck's signature card face is transient (visible only during the flip). To QA it visually, use the auto-play button and watch for the '✨ <label> <yards> yd' toast + play-by-play entries, which are stable signals.
